policy: Immutable g2/s1 package, run, workspace, and guard trees are copied byte-for-byte only where absent; existing files are verified identical and never overwritten. The Lane B ledger is preserved as a separate checkpoint snapshot; master's ledger is only ever appended to through WorkflowAuditLedgerService. Entries with bound=false are superseded Lane B artifacts the exit handoff does not bind; they are preserved additively so nothing is worktree-only, and they carry no authority.
